# Quarterly review: orders from email to invoice

## Email orders come first
Purchase orders that arrive by email come first; phone orders stay on the order sheet for now [1].

::: notes
The client owner decided this on 13 October 2026.
:::

## About 40 email orders a day
About 40 purchase orders arrive by email each day [2].

::: notes
The operations team gave this count for October.
:::

## Invoices without retyping
The day's orders reach the bookkeeping system as invoices without retyping [3].

::: notes
This is the plan's fourth change.
:::

## A weekly email, no standing call
Updates come as a short weekly email, with no standing call [4].

::: notes
Agreed at the check-in on 13 October 2026.
:::

## Next quarter
We recommend reviewing the phone orders once the spring rush ends.

::: notes
An opinion, not a sourced fact.
:::

## Sources

1. The owner's decision on email orders, Larkspur Ceramics, 13 October 2026.
2. October order count, Larkspur Ceramics, 27 October 2026.
3. The plan's new process, Larkspur Ceramics, 15 October 2026.
4. Check-in notes, 13 October 2026, Larkspur Ceramics, 13 October 2026.
